title: I’m Building an AI That Knows Me Too Well 🤯 | FRIDAY AI
description:
What if your AI didn't just answer questions… but actually knew you?
I'm building FRIDAY — my own personal AI assistant designed to understand my preferences, remember context, and become more useful over time.
This is not just another chatbot.
I'm documenting the journey of building it from the ground up.
FRIDAY AI — an AI that knows you.
Follow the journey. More coming soon. 🚀
